issue_context.title: Pull API returning null
issue_context.body:
- Gitea version (or commit ref): 51f6a7ab1
- Can you reproduce the bug at https://try.gitea.io:
  - [x] Yes (provide example URL) 
https://gitea.com/api/swagger#/repository/repoGetPullRequest
```
owner = gitea
repo = go-sdk
index = 217
```

## Description

I deleted my fork of `go-sdk` and now the API call is "failing" because it returns `nil`.  
Note "failing" because it _does_ return a response, but it's `null`.

This is the offending func:  
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/3c8a5d8783f23eca06eabc5903183f4a2bca2606/modules/convert/pull.go#L18

Shouldn't be too hard to fix, but we need to distinguish what qualifies returning `nil` rather than as much data as possible, because currently returning `null` in the JSON response means PRs will get missed by services using API calls.
comments:
So presumably the problem is here:

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/3c8a5d8783f23eca06eabc5903183f4a2bca2606/modules/convert/pull.go#L39-L43

One you've deleted your head repo that will return an `ErrRepoNotExist`. That should just be ignored and the nil repo coped with here:

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/3c8a5d8783f23eca06eabc5903183f4a2bca2606/modules/convert/pull.go#L102-L129

review_comments: In the case that the head repo is nil maybe we need to give some placeholder information (?) - similar to what the UI gives?

Maybe?

```go
apiHeadBranchInfo := &api.PRBranchInfo{
    Name: pr.HeadBranch,
    Ref: pr.HeadBranch,
    RepoID: -1,
} 
```
In the UI we should really be reporting the repo as "(deleted)"
